title: Offline play: UI shell
description: The shell for playing one human against rule bots on this device: start-screen entry, setup form, My offline games, resume progress, the offline banner that names the features that are off, and the queued-feedback state. All shots are the real app with an in-memory stand-in for the offline launcher (the wasm host is a later task), so no game board is shown.

shots.heading: Start screen entry
shots.caption: Play offline appears under My games when the build has an offline launcher registered. Without one the button is absent.

shots.heading: Setup form
shots.caption: 3 to 6 players, your seat (or random), your faction (or random), nickname. Every other seat is a rule bot. The Seed field is shown only in dev builds, as in the online lobby; the banner at the top already says what is not available offline.

shots.heading: My offline games
shots.caption: Each saved game with faction, table size, round and phase, seat, age and how long restoring takes. Resume (View for a finished game), Export a backup file, Delete.

shots.heading: My offline games on a phone
shots.caption: Rows wrap; buttons keep a 44 px height.

shots.heading: Delete asks first
shots.caption: Delete turns the row's buttons into a confirmation.

shots.heading: Resume progress
shots.caption: Replaying a saved game can take up to about 14 s. The bar shows the replayed move count and percent, says how long a long game takes, and can be cancelled.

shots.heading: Loading the engine
shots.caption: While the total is unknown (engine download, new game setup) the bar is indeterminate.

shots.heading: Browser without JSPI
shots.caption: Chrome or Edge 137+ only in v1. The reason is shown, the setup form is hidden and saved games cannot be resumed.

shots.heading: A save that cannot be replayed
shots.caption: The error stays on the screen with the list below it, so the save can still be exported or deleted.

shots.heading: Offline banner above a game
shots.caption: The strip names what is off, taken from the capability flags: map splice preview, turn redo, advisor, multiplayer. The game board itself (a later task) sits below it; this placeholder stands in for it.

shots.heading: Feedback during an offline game
shots.caption: The existing feedback sheet, unchanged to the user.

shots.heading: Queued feedback
shots.caption: Send does not wait for the network: the report is saved on this device with the seed, the answers and the engine hash, and goes to the server in the background. The sheet says Will be sent.

shots.heading: Queue chip
shots.caption: A small chip in the banner counts reports still to be sent, and offers Retry when a send failed.

shots.heading: Queue chip on a phone
shots.caption: The chip drops under the banner text.

notes.title: Not shown
notes.text: Real game play, the real wasm launcher, IndexedDB storage and the background sender are T3 to T5. The feedback queue's states (sending, failed) are covered by unit tests; only queued is drawn here.
